title: TinyMCE 8 editor on description fields
summary: Long text fields can now use a rich text editor for headings, lists, links and tables. Everything entered is cleaned on the server before it is saved.
changes: Add the TinyMCE editor to ticket descriptions and replies, case details and updates, consultation notes and recruitment role descriptions.
Show formatted text safely on tickets, cases, consultations and role pages.
Existing plain text keeps its line breaks.
The editor only appears once the TinyMCE key is configured; until then fields stay plain text boxes.
version_rationale: Patch: adds an optional editor and sanitising to existing text fields; stored data keeps its shape.
validation: New feature test for the editor with and without a key, sanitised saving, safe display and plain text.
New frontend test for the editor set-up.
Ticket, case, consultation, recruitment and security tests; full PHPUnit suite in CI.
known_limitations: The editor needs TINYMCE_API_KEY and approved domains at tiny.cloud. Recruitment role summaries stay plain text.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Formatted text saved by this release would then show its HTML tags as plain text.
provenance: Milestone v0.50.2 Beta, issue #483 under epic #481, pull request #621.
